title: Figure 6: Deformation map for metallic glasses (normalized stress vs T/Tg)
description: Color-shaded deformation map plotting normalized shear stress τ/µ against temperature normalized to the glass transition (T/Tg), with a secondary axis of shear stress at 300 K (GPa). Regions are labeled "Inhomogeneous deformation (shear localization)", "Elastic (negligible flow)", "Homogeneous deformation", "Non-Newtonian" and "Newtonian", with dashed strain-rate contours from 10^-10 to 1 s^-1. The caption notes values are representative of bulk metallic glass Zr41.2Ti13.8Cu12.5Ni10Be22.5.
